environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind CloudFront distribution (ID: E2XYZABC123) with a CloudFront Function (cf-fn-sri-gate) attached to viewer-response event stage. The CloudFront Function implements a content integrity check by maintaining a signed manifest (stored in CloudFront KeyValueStore 'sri-manifest-prod') mapping callback endpoint paths to their expected sha384 digests. The CloudFront Function intercepts responses from the origin (callback endpoints) via Origin Response event and compares the response body hash against the KeyValueStore entry. Non-matching responses receive a 403 with empty body before reaching Lambda. Additionally, the Lambda function's VPC configuration routes all egress through a NAT Gateway whose elastic IP is the only IP whitelisted in the CloudFront distribution's origin access policy - meaning the Lambda can ONLY fetch callback scripts through the CloudFront distribution, not directly from callback endpoints. The S3 context bucket has object lock enabled with GOVERNANCE mode retention of 30 seconds, preventing immediate context reuse within the race window.
